description: Names the business's own places, when it has any: its shop, office, studio, kitchen or venue at its real address, or an imagined home such as a mascot's HQ (real: false). Each with what it is in a sentence, and for a real place where it is. Then send pictures of it with add_pictures or get_upload_link, giving place: Create lists it first under Places, and a picture or film set there is made from those pictures. A name already on file is updated, never doubled. Works during setup and after it (give project when no setup is open). Spends nothing.

places.description: One or more places, each with its name, what it is and, for a real one, where.

name.description: Its name, as the business calls it.

real.description: true for a real address (the default), false for an imagined place.

what.description: What it is, in a sentence.

where.description: For a real place: its address, or its street and city.

project.description: Only with no setup open: the project's id or exact name.

name: add_places
title: Name the business's own places
